summary.en:
- Jiaoqiu is a support unit that debuffs the enemies with Ashen Roast, a unique DoT that also works gives Vulnerability. His Ultimate deploys a Zone that makes so his debuffs are unremovable and carry through waves.
- His debuffs at a base are 35% Vulnerability (15% + 5% for every stack of Ashen Roast above 1) and 15% specifically for Ultimates (with his zone). The extra utility he provides is mostly noticeable in Pure Fiction, as the debuffs carry over between waves.

details.en:
- S1 [[light-cone:those-many-springs]] offers the highest Effect Hit Rate% on a cone at 60%, as well as more Vulnerability and even more for Ultimates.
- E1 offers quicker ramp up (often negligeable) as well as a bit of an extra amplificatiom.
- E2 increases the damage of his Ashen Roast DoT, but it is only really impactful for DoT comps. Even so, there are better options, even for sustainless DoT teams.
